item.title: Robotics startup SynapX reportedly raises hundreds of millions of yuan, with Midea joining
item.dc:creator: TechNode Feed
item.description: Chinese robotics startup SynapX has secured several hundred million yuan in new funding, with Midea among the new investors, Blue Whale News reported, citing people familiar with the matter. item.title: Lenovo’s Lecoo launches walking-assist exoskeleton from RMB 6,999
item.dc:creator: TechNode Feed
item.description: Lenovo’s Lecoo brand has listed the Xingzhe ONE wearable exoskeleton in China, with an introductory price of RMB 6,999 and sales scheduled to begin on November 28. The device weighs 1.8 kilograms and uses powered hip joints to assist walking and other outdoor activities. The exoskeleton provides up to 38 Nm of peak hip torque […]

item.title: Honor launches 700 series with rear displays and 9,000mAh batteries
item.dc:creator: TechNode Feed
item.description: Honor launched its 700 smartphone series in China on Monday, adding rear displays and 9,000mAh batteries across a lineup starting at RMB 3,399 before subsidies. item.title: ByteDance opens invitation-only beta for Xiaodou personal AI assistant

item.description: ByteDance’s Doubao team opened a public beta for its personal AI assistant Xiaodou on Tuesday, giving invited users access to a separate product whose capabilities will gradually be introduced into the main Doubao app. The beta requires an invitation code and includes an allocation of free usage credits.
